Class SceneManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.view.GUI.Core.SceneManager
public class SceneManager extends Object
Manages all scene transitions for the GUI client. Loads and switches between JavaFX scenes, injects dependencies into controllers, and routes messages and updates to the currently active controller.

  • Method Details

    • loadLoginScene

      public void loadLoginScene()
      Loads and displays the login scene. Injects the GUI into the login controller.

    • loadLobbyScene

      public void loadLobbyScene(ClientController clientController)
      Loads and displays the lobby scene. Stores the client controller for use by subsequent scenes.
      Parameters:
      clientController - the client controller to inject into lobby-related controllers

    • loadTotemScene

      public void loadTotemScene(int id, int numPlayers, LobbyInfoDTO dto)
      Loads and displays the totem choice scene. Injects the client controller and scene manager, and sets the scene parameters.
      Parameters:
      id - -1 if creating a new game, the game id if joining
      numPlayers - the number of players for the new game, used only in create mode
      dto - the lobby data for the game being joined, or null in create mode

    • loadWaitingRoom

      public void loadWaitingRoom()
      Loads and displays the waiting room scene. Clears the lobby and totem controllers since they are no longer needed.

    • loadGameScene

      public GameControllerGUI loadGameScene()
      Loads and displays the main game scene. Injects the client controller, scene manager, game model and local nickname. Clears the lobby and totem controllers since they are no longer needed.
      Returns:
      the GameControllerGUI instance, or null if loading failed

    • loadEndScene

      public void loadEndScene()
      Loads and displays the end game scene. If a leaderboard was received before this scene was loaded, applies it immediately.

    • updateLobby

      public void updateLobby(List<LobbyInfoDTO> lobby)
      Forwards a lobby update to the active totem controller and lobby controller.
      Parameters:
      lobby - the updated list of available games

    • updateClientState

      public void updateClientState(ClientState currentState)
      Updates the current client state and triggers a scene transition when needed. Loads the end game scene when the state is END_GAME. Loads the waiting room when the state is WAITING_PLAYERS, which covers both the normal post-join flow and the reconnection case where the player was in an abandoned game and needs to wait for it to resume.
      Parameters:
      currentState - the new client state

    • showMessage

      public void showMessage(String message)
      Routes a message to the currently active controller based on the client state. In LOBBY state, routes to the lobby or totem controller. In IN_GAME state, routes to the game controller.
      Parameters:
      message - the message to display

    • showLeaderboard

      public void showLeaderboard(List<GameResult> leaderboard, int position)
      Displays the all-time leaderboard on the end game screen. If the end game scene is already loaded, applies immediately. Otherwise, stores the data to be applied when the scene loads.
      Parameters:
      leaderboard - the list of all-time game results
      position - the 1-based position of the local player in the leaderboard
